proposed_comments.title: Preserve existing PasteFormats telemetry IDs
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve existing PasteFormats telemetry IDs

**Severity:** `high`

Inserting `PasteAsJpgFile` before the existing HTML and transcode values renumbers every following `PasteFormats` member. These enum values are emitted directly in format-click and in-app-shortcut telemetry, so existing dashboards and persisted numeric payloads will interpret old actions as different formats after upgrade. Please assign the new action an explicit unused stable value and keep display ordering separate from the persisted telemetry ID.

confidence.rationale: The enum is serialized into telemetry and the current insertion changes the numeric values of existing members.

proposed_comments.title: Normalize clipboard bitmaps before JPEG encoding
proposed_comments.body:
### Normalize clipboard bitmaps before JPEG encoding

**Severity:** `high`

`GetImageContentAsync()` can return valid clipboard images in formats that `BitmapEncoder.SetSoftwareBitmap` does not accept, such as grayscale formats, and JPEG cannot preserve alpha. Passing the decoded bitmap directly can therefore fail for valid clipboard content or produce incorrect transparent-image output. Convert to a supported pixel format and define the alpha compositing behavior before calling `SetSoftwareBitmap`, with coverage for a grayscale image and a transparent image.

confidence.rationale: The encoder API accepts only a limited set of pixel formats, while clipboard decoding preserves the source format and JPEG has no alpha channel.

proposed_comments.title: Keep large-image JPEG conversion memory bounded
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep large-image JPEG conversion memory bounded

**Severity:** `medium`

Please avoid materializing several full-frame buffers while normalizing a large clipboard image for JPEG output. A 4000×3000 BGRA image is about 48 MB per copy, so repeated bitmap conversions and managed buffer copies can consume hundreds of megabytes in the large-photo scenario this action is intended to support. Prefer a locked-buffer or bounded row-wise conversion path, and add coverage or a documented limit for large transparent images.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The concern spans the bitmap normalization and encoding pipeline; no single current RIGHT-side range is a safe independently applicable replacement.

confidence.rationale: The converged fork review repeatedly identified the full-frame allocation pattern, and the feature specifically targets large photos.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve hotkey IDs for legacy settings
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve hotkey IDs for legacy settings

**Severity:** `high`

Adding the new child action in the middle of `SubActions` changes the positional hotkey sequence for users whose older settings file has no JPEG property yet. The Settings model creates the missing backing field, while the native module can still enumerate only actions physically present in the legacy JSON, so HTML and later actions can be assigned the wrong IDs until settings are rewritten. Preserve the existing serialized positions with an explicit migration or native placeholder before inserting the new action into the displayed order.

confidence.rationale: The settings and native enumeration paths do not consume legacy JSON identically, and the inserted child changes the positional sequence.

proposed_comments.title: Hide disabled JPEG shortcuts
proposed_comments.body:
### Hide disabled JPEG shortcuts

**Severity:** `medium`

This appends the JPEG shortcut whenever the parent `Paste as file` group is shown, even if the JPEG action's own `IsShown` toggle is false. Advanced Paste checks both visibility levels when activating the action, so Shortcut Guide can advertise a shortcut that the user has disabled. Guard this entry with `PasteAsJpgFile.IsShown` as well as the parent visibility.

confidence.rationale: The settings model has independent parent and child visibility, but this new Shortcut Guide entry checks only the parent.
